The 1972–73 [[Primeira Liga|Primeira Divisão]] was the 39th season of [[Portuguese football league system|top-tier]] [[Association football|football]] in Portugal.

==Overview==
It was contested by 16 teams. [[S.L. Benfica]] won the championship, with 28 victories, 0 losses and 2 draws.

This was also the first time that only one of the [[Big Three (Portugal)|Big Three]] finished in the top three spots in the table.
